verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing and remote-control app. Event webhooks for things like session or connection events are a plausible capability for remote-access tools, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks; the docs stress there is no account and no server, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
